people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Joash
people.line: King of Judah, son of Ahaziah

people.name: Zibiah
people.line: Mother of King Joash (or 'Jehoash') of Judah from Beersheba

translations.web: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
translations.bsb: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
translations.kjv: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
translations.asv: In the seventh year of Jehu began Jehoash to reign; and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
